summary: Backend regression for HEMELEY Wallet & Escrow Phase 1+2. Created /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_phase1_2.py with 25 pytest cases covering wallet auto-create + HMAC integrity, transactions, recharge (min amount + CAMPAY demo path + audit), webhook HMAC signature (401 paths), vendor withdrawals (min/insufficient/success), admin finance overview, list wallets/transactions/audit-logs/withdrawals, freeze/unfreeze, adjust + reject flow, permission boundaries. 24/25 PASSED. 1 real bug found: GET /api/wallet/me returns 500 for super_admin/admin users due to Pydantic Literal mismatch on WalletRole.

critical.issue: Returns 500 ValidationError. Wallet.role Literal accepts only ['customer','vendor','delivery','admin_escrow','admin_commissions'] but auth resolves admin token role as 'super_admin'. Spec required: 'auto-creates wallet for customer/vendor/delivery/admin on first call'.
critical.suggested_fix: Either (a) extend WalletRole Literal to include 'admin' and 'super_admin', OR (b) in routes_wallet._resolve_actor map 'super_admin'/'admin' role to a synthetic admin wallet (e.g. role='admin_escrow' for SYSTEM_ESCROW user_id, or create a personal admin wallet under role 'admin'). Recommended: add 'admin' to WalletRole literal and use it for super_admin personal wallets so admin_escrow / admin_commissions remain SYSTEM-only.

minor.issue: Order of checks: balance < amount → 400 'Solde insuffisant' fires before wallet.status check (wallet.status is verified inside _update_wallet_balance). When a frozen wallet has zero balance, user sees 'Solde insuffisant' instead of clearer 'Portefeuille frozen — opération bloquée'. Move freeze check up to the route handler for clearer UX.

Current implementation inserts recharge_request row ONLY when CAMPAY accepts the call. If CAMPAY raises (502 path), the request row is never persisted — contradicts spec line 'Recharge_request row should be inserted regardless'. Recommend persisting a recharge_request with status='failed' even when CAMPAY initiation fails so admin has full audit trail.

On CAMPAY failure the wallet is refunded and a 'withdrawal_reject' tx is recorded, but the audit log does NOT receive a 'withdrawal.fail' (or similar) entry — only the success path writes 'withdrawal.approve'. Missing audit trail on failure approvals.

passed_tests: GET /api/wallet/me as customer — auto-create + HMAC integrity_hash matches local recompute
GET /api/wallet/me as vendor — auto-create + HMAC integrity_hash valid
POST /api/wallet/recharge valid amount in demo → 502 with French error 'Erreur CAMPAY'
GET /api/admin/finance/overview returns escrow_balance, escrow_held, commissions_balance, by_role, pending_withdrawals_count/amount, total_recharges
GET /api/admin/wallets — confirms BOTH SYSTEM wallets exist: (SYSTEM_ESCROW, admin_escrow) and (SYSTEM_COMMISSIONS, admin_commissions)
GET /api/admin/transactions — every tx reference matches ^TXN-HEMELEY-\d{8}-[A-F0-9]{6}$ and has signature field
POST /api/admin/wallets/{id}/adjust delta=5000 → balance += 5000, version+1, integrity_hash recomputed correctly
End-to-end: adjust credit → vendor withdrawal request → admin reject without reason 400 → reject with reason 200 → wallet refunded
Permissions: customer cannot list /api/admin/wallets → 401/403; vendor cannot freeze wallet → 401/403
action_items: FIX HIGH: Resolve role mismatch in /api/wallet/me for super_admin/admin tokens (extend WalletRole Literal to include 'admin' and map 'super_admin' → 'admin' in _resolve_actor). Right now any admin login that hits the wallet UI gets 500.
PERSIST recharge_request row even when CAMPAY initiation fails (status='failed', failure_reason set), to keep full audit trail per spec.
Reorder checks in POST /api/wallet/withdrawals: verify wallet.status == 'active' before balance check so frozen users get the correct French error message.
Add audit log entry when admin withdrawal approval triggers a CAMPAY payout failure + auto-refund.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet_models.WalletRole Literal does not cover the 'admin'/'super_admin' role coming from auth — root cause of /api/wallet/me 500.

routes_wallet._resolve_actor swallows ALL exceptions on customer-token path (try/except (HTTPException, KeyError, Exception)) — this can hide bugs and downgrade real auth errors. Narrow to expected exceptions.

routes_wallet.py: instantiates a local Creds class to fake HTTPAuthorizationCredentials — fragile. Prefer FastAPI's Security/Depends pattern or a single helper that decodes the JWT once and dispatches by role.

routes_wallet.initiate_recharge: recharge_request row is inserted only when CAMPAY succeeds (call wrapped in try). Spec requires the row regardless. Move the insert before the CAMPAY call (status='pending'), then update with campay_reference / failure_reason after.
wallet_service._update_wallet_balance does NOT retry on optimistic-concurrency 409 — under real concurrent load callers will receive 409 frequently. Consider 1-2 retry attempts inside the function.

routes_admin_wallet.adjust_wallet uses raw `await request.json()` instead of a Pydantic body model — bypasses validation and lacks OpenAPI schema. Add an AdjustRequest(BaseModel) {delta:float, reason:str}.

routes_admin_wallet.freeze_wallet/unfreeze_wallet bypass _update_wallet_balance and write directly to db — they correctly bump version + integrity_hash, but if status is already frozen/active, no idempotency guard. Add a check.

routes_wallet.campay_webhook: when amount mismatch is detected, returns {success:False} with HTTP 200 — this stops CAMPAY's retry, which is desirable, but the failure_reason='amount_mismatch' should also write a wallet_audit_log entry.

wallet_security.sign_payload uses str(p) for floats — works because callers pre-format with f'{x:.2f}', but a future caller might pass a raw float and silently break HMAC verification. Add an assertion or normalize inside sign_payload.
Token resolution: customer/vendor login both return token; backend has no token-revocation list. JWT_SECRET is hardcoded-looking string in .env (acceptable for dev but flag for prod).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests credit/debit and reject within the same flow to leave vendor wallet balance unchanged. SYSTEM_ESCROW and SYSTEM_COMMISSIONS wallets auto-created on admin overview call (if not already present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1+2 wallet ledger is solid. 24/25 tests green. The single failing test (TestWalletMe::test_admin_wallet_auto_created) is a genuine backend bug — the WalletRole Literal in /app/backend/wallet_models.py does not accept 'admin' or 'super_admin', so the existing JWT role of admin@hemeley.com (super_admin) crashes /api/wallet/me with 500. Once main agent extends WalletRole and/or maps super_admin to a valid wallet role inside routes_wallet._resolve_actor, re-run the suite: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_phase1_2.py -v`. CAMPAY demo always returns 401 from upstream (not our problem; tests already accept 502 path).

rca of the issue.bug: GET /api/wallet/me crashes with HTTP 500 when called by an admin/super_admin user.
rca of the issue.root_cause: wallet_models.py defines `WalletRole = Literal['customer','vendor','delivery','admin_escrow','admin_commissions']`. routes_wallet._resolve_actor returns the user's actual auth role ('super_admin' or 'admin'), which is then passed verbatim into Wallet(user_id=..., role=role) inside wallet_service.get_or_create_wallet. Pydantic v2 validation raises literal_error.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/login with admin@hemeley.com / hemeley2024 → token. 2) GET /api/wallet/me with that token → 500 {'detail':'Internal server error','type':'ValidationError'}.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Either extend WalletRole to include 'admin' (and map 'super_admin'→'admin' in _resolve_actor before calling get_or_create_wallet), or short-circuit /api/wallet/me for admin roles to return the SYSTEM_ESCROW (or both system) wallets. Recommended: add 'admin' to WalletRole and treat super_admin personal wallet as role='admin'.
